# codescope

> Code-intelligence engine for AI coding agents — single Rust binary indexes any repo into a queryable graph over MCP, CLI, and JSON.

codescope is maintained by Adventure Wave Labs (The lab for agentic developer tooling).

## Links

- [Landing page](https://adventurewave-labs.github.io/codescope/): overview, features, FAQ
- [Source code](https://github.com/adventurewave-labs/codescope): README, issues, releases
## Install

```
brew install marcuspat/tap/codescope
```
